A craggy '''planet''' was located somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]] and [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Suljo Warde]] stopped at the planet and left his [[Holocron of Suljo Warde|holocron]] on the planet's surface.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''</ref>
